_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for TIME-SENSITIVE Future Ready figures (federal loan rates, Pell max, FAFSA timing). Every chart/graph and money-math page reads from here so nothing is hard-coded twice. Update ANNUALLY when new federal figures publish.
_meta.review_trigger: Federal Direct Loan rates for the new academic year publish each year in late May (fsapartners.ed.gov, effective for loans first disbursed July 1). Re-verify EVERY figure below against its source_url, bump last_verified + last_reviewed, and move review_by forward one year.
_meta.maintainer_note: Rates current through AY2026-27 (undergraduate 6.52%, added 2026-08-05 from FSA Electronic Announcement 2026-06-04; see direct_loan_rates_undergrad.by_year_provenance). Next: the AY2027-28 undergraduate rate publishes ~late May 2027 — add it then and move review_by forward.
verified_against: U.S. Dept. of Education / Federal Student Aid

direct_loan_rates_undergrad.label: Federal Direct Loan fixed APR — undergraduate Direct Subsidized/Unsubsidized

direct_loan_rates_undergrad.by_year_provenance: AY2026-27 = 6.52% per FSA Electronic Announcement 2026-06-04 (10-yr Treasury note high yield 4.468% at the 2026-05-12 auction + 2.05 undergraduate add-on = 6.518, rounded to 6.52). https://fsapartners.ed.gov/knowledge-center/library/electronic-announcements/2026-06-04/interest-rates-federal-direct-loans-first-disbursed-between-july-1-2026-and-june-30-2027
